task: Predict lymph node presentation status in gastric adenocarcinoma. Classes: node negative vs. node positive. Key H&E indicators include depth of invasion, lymphovascular invasion, infiltrative growth, poor differentiation, and tumor budding, which increase the likelihood of nodal spread.

classes.0: Node-negative gastric adenocarcinoma with more localized growth and fewer histologic signs of lymphatic dissemination.
classes.1: Node-positive gastric adenocarcinoma showing infiltrative invasion, lymphovascular invasion, tumor budding, or other features associated with metastatic spread to regional nodes.
